newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Siderar down after results. [corrected 00:08 gmt 8/5]
newsitem.headline: Argentine Siderar down after results. [corrected 00:08 gmt 8/5]

text.p: Argentine steelmaker Siderar fell 4.5 percent to $3.8 in early trading Wednesday on the bolsa on disappointment over company results released after Tuesday's close, dealers said.
Siderar posted a net profit of $59 million in the nine months to March 31 compared to $35 million in the same period of the previous year.

"The consensus estimate for the third-quarter profit was $14 million (corrects from 17-$18 million), but it came in at $11.3 million, below our own forecast of $12 million," said Dario Lizzano at Santander Investment.
Traders noted the case of Siderar was similar to that of steelmaker Acindar, whose weaker-than-expected results two weeks ago triggered a bout of profit-taking.
"The market seems to have unrealistic expectations for the steel sector, which in fact is doing very well," another trader said.
Siderar's fall contrasted with a 1.3 percent drop in the blue-chip MerVal index index to 724.72 which traders blamed on profit-taking on the New York markets.
